material.title: Acme fires new 700 tpd container glass furnace, adding 230,000 t of annual capacity
material.bodyOriginal: Acme today announced the successful ignition of its new 700-tonne-per-day container glass furnace at its packaging plant, adding 230,000 tonnes of annual capacity for wine and beverage bottles. Full production on the forming line is expected by November 2026.
